proposals.evidence: Full māṃsa gives Pali/Prakrit maṃsa and Prakrit māsa, eastern mā̃s/mās and Oriya māũsa, Jaunsari mās, Gujarati/Marathi mā̃s and Sindhi māhu. These support the eastern maŋso/maŋśo/maŋʃo and māus/mə̃us-type meat forms and western maso/moso/maṣ. Western mah/māh/maha/mahã and māx are provisional family matches with weakened sibilant; the local conditioning is not established merely by the Sindhi comparison. Preserve source vowels, nasal/affricate realizations and endings. Cross-IA transmission is qualified; no Sindhi or Sinhalese loan is asserted. Exact response: maha.
